You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value, sometimes a condition, and the place it comes from.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the facts, step by step: a repeal or a
  limit "from 20 January" does not yet apply on 16 January.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the facts.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Which category does a safety component with self-evolving behaviour based on machine learning fall under?

Facts:
[0] safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour — listedIn — Safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour (annex I part A point 5) [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 5]
[1] machinery with embedded self-evolving ML systems ensuring safety functions — listedIn — 6. (annex I, part A, point 6) [condition: in respect only of those systems] [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 6]
[2] self-evolving machinery — requiresMeasure — adapting machinery or a related product (adapting machinery or a related product) [condition: where relevant] [REG, Annex III, 1.1.6]
[3] Autonomous mobile machinery — definedAs — has an autonomous mode (has an autonomous mode) [condition: all essential safety functions ensured without permanent interaction of an operator] [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[4] autonomous mobile machinery — requiresMeasure — devices intended to detect any human, domestic animal or any other obstacle in its vicinity (devices intended to detect any human, domestic animal or any other obstacle in its vicinity) [condition: where those obstacles could give rise to a risk to the health and safety of persons or domestic animals or to the safe operation of the machinery or related product] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.3]
[5] Universal Robots robots built-in safety functions — hasSafetyFunction — Performance Level d (PLd) using a category 3 architecture (PL d, category 3) [ur5e-manual, p. 109]
[6] safety component — definedAs — ‘safety component’ means a physical or digital component (‘safety component’ means a physical or digital component) [condition: but which is not necessary in order for that product to function or for which normal components may be substituted in order for that product to function] [REG, Art. 3(3)]
[7] Safety function — definedAs — Function of a machine whose failure can result in an immediate increase of the risk(s) (function of a machine whose failure can result in an immediate increase of the risk(s)) [nanoscan3-manual, p. 147]
[8] autonomous mobile machinery — requiresMeasure — an enclosed zone fitted with a peripheral protection system comprising guards or protective devices (an enclosed zone fitted with a peripheral protection system comprising guards or protective devices) [condition: with one or both where necessary according to the risk assessment] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.3]
[9] autonomous mobile machinery — requiresMeasure — supervisory function specific to the autonomous mode (supervisory function specific to the autonomous mode) [condition: Where relevant] [REG, Annex III, 3.2.4]
[10] built-in safety functions of UR10e — hasSafetyFunction — Performance Level d (PLd) using a category 3 architecture (PLd, category 3) [ur10e-manual, p. 110]
[11] 2.3(d) non-fully automated machine — addressesRisk — risk of accidental injury (risk of accidental injury) [condition: where the tool is incorporated into a non-fully automated machine] [DIR, Annex I, 2.3]
[12] category of machinery or related product — listedIn — Annex I, Part A (annex i, part a) [condition: if, according to the assessment referred to in paragraph 4, and taking into account the available information, it presents a serious inherent potential risk, and one or more of the following conditions is fulfilled] [REG, Art. 6(7)]
[13] control system — requiresMeasure — designed to perform the safety functions by itself (designed to perform the safety functions by itself) [condition: For autonomous mobile machinery or related product; even when actions are ordered by using a remote supervisory function] [REG, Annex III, 3.3]
[14] control systems for pedestrian-controlled machinery — addressesRisk — inadvertent movement of the machinery towards the driver (inadvertent movement of the machinery towards the driver) [REG, Annex III, 3.3.4]
[15] machinery with collision risk — requiresMeasure — fit systems enabling these risks to be avoided (fit systems enabling these risks to be avoided) [condition: where several fixed or rail-mounted machines can be manoeuvred simultaneously in the same place, with risks of collision] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.6]
[16] non-fully automated machinery with incorporated tool — addressesRisk — risk of accidental injury (risk of accidental injury) [condition: where the tool is incorporated into non-fully automated machinery or a related product] [REG, Annex III, 2.3]
[17] category of machinery or related product — requiresProcedure — conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) (conformity based on full quality assurance (module h)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A] [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[18] UR10e robot arm in Recovery Mode — hasSafetyFunction — Stop Category 0 (stop category 0) [condition: if a violation of these limits appears] [ur10e-manual, p. 200]
[19] essential requirement 1.7.1.2 (warning devices) — addressesRisk — a fault in the operation of unsupervised machinery (a fault in the operation of unsupervised machinery) [DIR, Annex I, 1.7.1.2]
[20] remote-controlled machinery — requiresMeasure — devices for stopping operation automatically and immediately (devices for stopping operation automatically and immediately) [condition: if the driver loses control, if it receives a stop signal, if a fault is detected in a safety-related part of the system, if no validation signal is detected within a specified time] [DIR, Annex I, 3.3.3]
[21] Machinery or related products presenting risks due to their mobility — definedAs — operatedwithout being moved (operatedwithout being moved) [condition: machinery operated without being moved but which may be equipped to be moved more easily] [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[22] effectiveness of the protective measure — requiresCheckAfter — each change to the machine, the integration or the operating and boundary conditions of the safety laser scanner (each change to the machine, the integration or the operating and boundary conditions of the safety laser scanner) [nanoscan3-manual, p. 104]
[23] Arresto di sicurezza — hasSafetyFunction — Categoria 3 della Norma ISO 13849-1:1999 (categoria 3) [condition: o comunque come previsto dalla valutazione del rischio] [robot-cell-sheet, p. 4]
[24] autonomous mobile machinery or related products — mustAccompany — instructions for use (instructions for use) [REG, Annex III, 3.6.3.3]
[25] Machinery presenting hazards due to its mobility — definedAs — Machinery presenting hazards due to its mobility (machinery presenting hazards due to its mobility) [DIR, Annex I, 3.1.1]
[26] Arresto di emergenza — hasSafetyFunction — Categoria 3 della Norma ISO 13849-1:1999 (categoria 3) [condition: o comunque come previsto dalla valutazione del rischio] [robot-cell-sheet, p. 4]
[27] Universal Robots safety functions and safety I/O — hasSafetyFunction — PLd Category 3 (ISO 13849-1) (PLd Category 3) [ur10e-manual, p. 236]
[28] safety component — definedAs — means a component (means a component) [condition: which is independently placed on the market] [DIR, Art. 2]
[29] Machinery or related products presenting risks due to their mobility — definedAs — requires either mobility while working (requires either mobility while working) [condition: the operation requires mobility while working, or continuous or semi continuous movement between fixed working locations] [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[30] automatic-charging batteries of mobile machinery — addressesRisk — hazards referred to in sections 1.3.8.2 and 1.5.1 (hazards referred to in sections 1.3.8.2 and 1.5.1) [condition: when the machinery or related product moves autonomously to the charging station] [REG, Annex III, 3.5.1]
[31] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) (conformity based on full quality assurance (module h)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[32] indicative list of safety components — listedIn — Annex II (annex II) [condition: in the light of technical progress and knowledge or new scientific evidence] [REG, Art. 7(2)]
[33] control systems, safety and reliability — addressesRisk — hazardous situations (hazardous situations) [DIR, Annex I, 1.2.1]
[34] category of machinery or related product — requiresProcedure — conformity based on unit verification (module G) (conformity based on unit verification (module g)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A] [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[35] UR5e safety functions and safety I/O — hasSafetyFunction — PLd Category 3 (PLd Category 3) [ur5e-manual, p. 229]
[36] downstream control elements — integratorResponsibleFor — must evaluate the output signals of the protective device in such a way that the dangerous state of the machine is safely ended (must evaluate the output signals of the protective device in such a way that the dangerous state of the machine is safely ended) [nanoscan3-manual, p. 42]
[37] 1.3.7 moving parts — requiresMeasure — guards or protective devices (guards or protective devices) [condition: where risks persist] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.7]
[38] movement of machinery depending on safe positioning of parts — requiresMeasure — movement of the machinery shall depend on safe positioning (movement of the machinery shall depend on safe positioning) [condition: where it does not give rise to other risks] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.2]
[39] impianto robotizzato — hasSafetyFunction — Riavviamento Inatteso (riavviamento inatteso) [robot-cell-sheet, p. 3]
[40] starting in automatic mode — addressesRisk — hazardous situation (hazardous situation) [condition: provided this does not lead to a hazardous situation] [REG, Annex III, 1.2.3]
[41] warning devices — requiresMeasure — appropriate acoustic or light signal (appropriate acoustic or light signal) [condition: Where the health and safety of persons may be endangered by a fault in the operation of unsupervised machinery or a related product] [REG, Annex III, 1.7.1.2]
[42] self-propelled machinery travelling function — requiresMeasure — an emergency device with a fully independent and easily accessible control device (an emergency device with a fully independent and easily accessible control device) [condition: Where safety so requires, in the event of a failure of the main device, or in the absence of the energy supply needed to actuate the main device] [DIR, Annex I, 3.3.3]
[43] UR10e — hasSafetyFunction — Stop Category 0 (Stop Category 0) [condition: if a violation of these limits appears] [ur10e-manual, p. 119]
[44] category of machinery or related product — listedIn — Annex I, Part A (annex i, part a) [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[45] simultaneous manoeuvring with collision risk — requiresMeasure — fit systems enabling these risks to be avoided (fit systems enabling these risks to be avoided) [condition: Where several fixed or rail-mounted machinery or related products can be manoeuvred simultaneously in the same place, with risks of collision] [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.6]
[46] robot integration — integratorResponsibleFor — Perform a risk assessment (perform a risk assessment) [ur5e-manual, p. 4]
[47] robot integration — integratorResponsibleFor — Perform a risk assessment (perform a risk assessment) [ur10e-manual, p. 4]
[48] self-propelled machinery — requiresMeasure — an emergency device with a fully independent and easily accessible control device (an emergency device with a fully independent and easily accessible control device) [condition: Where safety so requires, in the event of a failure of the main device, or in the absence of the energy supply needed to actuate the main device] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.3]
[49] moving parts — requiresMeasure — fitted with guards or protective devices (fitted with guards or protective devices) [condition: where risks persist] [DIR, Annex I, 1.3.7]

response.text: {"kind":"text","value":"Annex I, Part A, point 5 (safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning approaches ensuring safety functions)","text":"Safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour are listed in Annex I, Part A, point 5 of the Regulation. Fact 1 adds that machinery with embedded self-evolving ML systems ensuring safety functions is listed at point 6, but only in respect of those systems.","used":[0,1]}
